description: This Java class 'FixedDepositImportHandler' implements an import handler for processing fixed deposit account data from Excel workbooks. It reads data from specified sheets, processes and converts spreadsheet rows into domain objects, and manages the import workflow including handling different processing stages like creation, approval, activation, and closing of fixed deposit accounts. It also logs commands to the platform service and records import success or failure with detailed error reporting.

classes.name: FixedDepositImportHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles importing fixed deposit account data from Excel workbooks, including reading and parsing data rows, creating domain objects, and executing import commands.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point for processing the workbook, reading data, and performing import operations.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads fixed deposit data and related approval, activation, and closing info from the Excel workbook.

methods.name: readSavingsClosed
methods.description: Reads and constructs data for closed savings accounts from a row.

methods.name: readSavingsActivation
methods.description: Reads and constructs data for savings account activation from a row.

methods.name: readSavingsApproval
methods.description: Reads and constructs data for savings account approval from a row.

methods.name: readSavings
methods.description: Reads and constructs data for a fixed deposit account from a row.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Handles the import execution for multiple fixed deposit records, including creation and processing of commands, error handling, and report updates.

methods.name: writeFixedDepositErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error messages and status updates into the Excel report for failed records.

methods.name: importSavingsClosing
methods.description: Creates and logs a command to close a fixed deposit account if applicable.

methods.name: importSavings
methods.description: Creates and logs a command to create a new fixed deposit account.

methods.name: importSavingsApproval
methods.description: Creates and logs a command to approve a fixed deposit account application.

methods.name: importSavingsActivation
methods.description: Creates and logs a command to activate a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the current processing stage of a record based on its status.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Sets up headers in the Excel report sheet for status and error reporting.
